answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to periodically mirror a randomly sampled interaction from its unique willow of past peer attestations. A challenge draws a ripple of three prior signed messages that must be re-proved under a fresh nonce within the epoch. Clones sharing one operator collapse because they cannot hold distinct willow histories; forging a matching mirror demands sequential live participation that cannot be parallelized. Each extra fake therefore needs its own non-overlapping history tree, so verification cost grows with every added head.
